# University of Toronto

> The University of Toronto's web presence provides student services, academic resources, and philanthropic engagement opportunities through integrated portals and campaigns.

This site serves as a hub for current students, alumni, and donors to access essential university services including registration and account management through ACORN, and to engage with the Defy Gravity fundraising campaign that supports institutional advancement and inclusive excellence across the university.

## Key Topics

- ACORN
- UTORid
- UTORMFA
- Student Portal
- Registration
- Account Management
- Defy Gravity Campaign
- University Philanthropy
- Alumni Engagement
- Fundraising
- Faculty of Law
- African Studies
- Inclusive Excellence
- Student Support
- Donation

## Student Services & Portal

- [Student Web Services | University of Toronto](http://www.acorn.utoronto.ca): ACORN student portal for registration, account management, and login services

## Philanthropy & Fundraising

- [Defy Gravity Campaign](https://boundless.utoronto.ca): Defy Gravity fundraising campaign for University of Toronto philanthropy
